summary: Improve FMCG outlet coverage, distributor reviews and sales reporting with practical case exercises. Explore the course and its outcomes.
lede: FMCG sales training helps sales representatives, distributor supervisors and commercial managers use outlet and sales data to prioritize field activity. You practise outlet segmentation and distribution calculations, review sell-in and sell-out alongside on-shelf availability, and use CRM records and performance evidence to build distributor scorecards and track sales actions.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who plan FMCG coverage, manage distributor execution or use outlet and sales data to guide field priorities.
modules: ABC Outlet Analysis and Call Plans
FMCG Sales Action Plan and Review
prerequisites: Recommended entry level: intermediate. Working familiarity with FMCG sales, retail distribution or distributor operations will help you apply the exercises. No programming is required; exercises use sales and outlet case data with Excel or a spreadsheet.
